cohort: The study included 1,317 pregnant women from the MAASTHI cohort in Bengaluru, India, who were interviewed at baseline and followed up.
finding: The study found that physical activity during pregnancy has several beneficial effects on maternal prenatal health outcomes, including a reduced risk of obesity and C-section delivery, lower blood glucose levels, and improved mental health.
mod_finding: Women who engaged in sedentary behavior during pregnancy were 4.32 times more likely to have elective cesarean section (C-section) delivery than those who engaged in moderate activity.
